747:     private function ensureInternalClassNamesLoaded(): void
748:     {
749:         if ([] !== $this->internalClassNames && [] !== $this->classReferenceNotBeforeKinds) {
750:             return;
751:         }
752:         $this->internalClassNames = [];
753:         foreach (get_declared_classes() as $class) {
754:             if ((new \ReflectionClass($class))->isInternal()) {
755:                 $this->internalClassNames[strtolower($class)] = $class;
756:             }
757:         }
758:         $this->classReferenceNotBeforeKinds = [
759:             CT::T_USE_TRAIT, T_AS, T_CASE, T_CLASS, T_CONST, T_DOUBLE_ARROW, T_DOUBLE_COLON,
760:             T_FUNCTION, T_INTERFACE, T_OBJECT_OPERATOR, T_TRAIT,
761:         ];
762:         if (\defined('T_NULLSAFE_OBJECT_OPERATOR')) {

764:         }
765:         if (\defined('T_ENUM')) {
766:             $this->classReferenceNotBeforeKinds[] = T_ENUM;
767:         }
768:         $this->classReferenceBlockKinds = ['before' => [','], 'after' => [',']];
769:         foreach (Tokens::getBlockEdgeDefinitions() as $definition) {
770:             $this->classReferenceBlockKinds['before'][] = $definition['start'];
771:             $this->classReferenceBlockKinds['after'][] = $definition['end'];
772:         }

774:             'Exception','InvalidArgumentException','LogicException','RuntimeException','UnexpectedValueException',

776:             'DateTime','DateTimeImmutable','ArrayObject','Closure','Generator','stdClass','Attribute',

785:     private function collectClassReferenceIndexes(Tokens $tokens, int $scopeStart, int $scopeEnd, bool $namespaceIsGlobal): \Generator
786:     {
787:         $this->ensureInternalClassNamesLoaded();
788:         for ($index = $scopeStart; $index < $scopeEnd; ++$index) {
789:             if (!$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
790:                 continue;
791:             }
792:             $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
793:             if ($tokens[$nextIndex]->isGivenKind(T_NS_SEPARATOR)) {
794:                 continue;
795:             }
796:             $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
797:             $isNamespaceSeparator = $tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_NS_SEPARATOR);
798:             if (!$isNamespaceSeparator && !$namespaceIsGlobal) {
799:                 continue;
800:             }
801:             if ($isNamespaceSeparator) {
802:                 $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($prevIndex);
803:                 if ($tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
804:                     continue;
805:                 }
806:             } elseif ($tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind($this->classReferenceNotBeforeKinds)) {
807:                 continue;
808:             }
809:             if ($tokens[$prevIndex]->equalsAny($this->classReferenceBlockKinds['before']) && $tokens[$nextIndex]->equalsAny($this->classReferenceBlockKinds['after'])) {
810:                 continue;
811:             }
812:             if (!$tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_NEW) && $tokens[$nextIndex]->equalsAny(['(', ';', [T_CLOSE_TAG]])) {
813:                 continue;
814:             }
815:             yield $index;
816:         }
817:     }

/**

 *

 */
final class ConstantCaseFixer extends AbstractFixer implements ConfigurableFixerInterface
{
    /**
     * Hold the function that will be used to convert the constants.
     *
     * @var callable
     */

    /** @var array<string, mixed> */
    private array $constantCaseContext = [];

    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $nativeConstantAliases = [];

    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $functionTypeHints = [];

    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $classConstSupportedHints = [];

    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $classPropertySupportedHints = [];

    /** @var list<array{int}|string> */
    private array $beforePropertyTypeTokens = [];

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $typeSeparationKinds = [];

    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $magicMethodNames = [];

    /** @var array<string, int> */
    private array $magicMethodScanLevel = [];

    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $internalClassNames = [];

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $classReferenceNotBeforeKinds = [];

    /** @var array{before: list<array{int}|string>, after: list<array{int}|string>} */
    private array $classReferenceBlockKinds = ['before' => [], 'after' => []];

    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $nativeFunctionNames = [];

    /** @var array<string, bool> */
    private array $nativeFunctionDecisionCache = [];

    /** @var array<int, string> */

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $magicConstantTokenKinds = [];

    /** @var array<string, string> */

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $staticReferencePrevSkipKinds = [];

    /** @var list<int> */
    private array $staticReferenceNextSkipKinds = [];

    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $integerLiteralPatterns = [];

    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $integerLiteralCache = [];

    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $reservedTypeNames = [];

    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $nullableTypeMarkers = [];

    /** @var array<string, mixed> */
    private array $classyElementCache = [];

    /** @var array<string, bool> */
    private array $classyInvocationCache = [];

    /** @var array<string, array<string, bool>> */
    private array $namespaceImportCache = [];

    /** @var array<string, array{start: int, end: int, global: bool}> */
    private array $namespaceScopeCache = [];

    /** @var array<string, bool> */
    private array $keywordExclusionFlags = [];

    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $keywordRewriteCache = [];

    public function configure(array $configuration): void
    {
        parent::configure($configuration);

        if ('lower' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtolower($content);
        }

        if ('upper' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtoupper($content);
        }
    }

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'The PHP constants `true`, `false`, and `null` MUST be written using the correct casing.',
            [
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n"),
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n", ['case' => 'upper']),
            ]
        );
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_STRING);
    }

    protected function createConfigurationDefinition(): FixerConfigurationResolverInterface
    {
        return new FixerConfigurationResolver([
            (new FixerOptionBuilder('case', 'Whether to use the `upper` or `lower` case syntax.'))
                ->setAllowedValues(['upper', 'lower'])
                ->setDefault('lower')
                ->getOption(),
        ]);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $fixFunction = $this->fixFunction;

        foreach ($tokens as $index => $token) {
            if (!$token->isNativeConstant()) {
                continue;
            }

            if (
                $this->isNeighbourAccepted($tokens, $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index))
                && $this->isNeighbourAccepted($tokens, $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index))
                && !$this->isEnumCaseName($tokens, $index)
            ) {
                $tokens[$index] = new Token([$token->getId(), $fixFunction($token->getContent())]);
            }
        }
    }

    private function isNeighbourAccepted(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        static $forbiddenTokens = null;

        if (null === $forbiddenTokens) {
            $forbiddenTokens = [
                T_AS,
                T_CLASS,
                T_CONST,
                T_EXTENDS,
                T_IMPLEMENTS,
                T_INSTANCEOF,
                T_INSTEADOF,
                T_INTERFACE,
                T_NEW,
                T_NS_SEPARATOR,
                T_PAAMAYIM_NEKUDOTAYIM,
                T_TRAIT,
                T_USE,
                CT::T_USE_TRAIT,
                CT::T_USE_LAMBDA,
                ...Token::getObjectOperatorKinds(),
            ];
        }

        $token = $tokens[$index];

        if ($token->equalsAny(['{', '}'])) {
            return false;
        }

        return !$token->isGivenKind($forbiddenTokens);
    }

    private function isEnumCaseName(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if (!\defined('T_ENUM') || !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_ENUM)) { // @TODO: drop condition when PHP 8.1+ is required
            return false;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);

        if (null === $prevIndex || !$tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_CASE)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_SWITCH)) {
            return true;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($prevIndex, [[T_ENUM], [T_SWITCH]]);

        return null !== $prevIndex && $tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_ENUM);
    }


    private function ensureConstantCaseContextReady(): void
    {
        if (isset($this->constantCaseContext['ready']) && true === $this->constantCaseContext['ready']) {
            return;
        }
        $this->nativeConstantAliases = [
            'true' => 'true',
            'false' => 'false',
            'null' => 'null',
        ];
        $this->constantCaseContext = [
            'ready' => true,
            'aliases' => $this->nativeConstantAliases,
            'values' => ['true' => true, 'false' => true, 'null' => true],
            'seen' => [],
        ];
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_true'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['true'] ?? 'true';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_false'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['false'] ?? 'false';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_null'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['null'] ?? 'null';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_TRUE'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['TRUE'] ?? 'TRUE';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_FALSE'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['FALSE'] ?? 'FALSE';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_NULL'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['NULL'] ?? 'NULL';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_True'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['True'] ?? 'True';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_False'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['False'] ?? 'False';
        $this->constantCaseContext['alias_Null'] = $this->nativeConstantAliases['Null'] ?? 'Null';
        if (!\is_callable($this->fixFunction)) {
            $this->constantCaseContext['fix_ready'] = false;
        } else {
            $this->constantCaseContext['fix_ready'] = true;
        }
    }

    private function isKnownNativeConstantName(string $content): bool
    {
        $this->ensureConstantCaseContextReady();
        $normalized = strtolower($content);
        if (isset($this->constantCaseContext['values'][$normalized])) {
            return true;
        }
        return isset($this->nativeConstantAliases[$normalized]);
    }

    private function canonicalNativeConstantName(string $content): string
    {
        $this->ensureConstantCaseContextReady();
        $normalized = strtolower($content);
        $canonical = $this->nativeConstantAliases[$normalized] ?? $normalized;
        if (\is_callable($this->fixFunction)) {
            $fixFunction = $this->fixFunction;
            return $fixFunction($canonical);
        }
        return $canonical;
    }

    private function recordConstantCandidate(int $index, string $content): void
    {
        $this->ensureConstantCaseContextReady();
        if (!$this->isKnownNativeConstantName($content)) {
            return;
        }
        $this->constantCaseContext['seen'][$index] = strtolower($content);
    }

    private function shouldRewriteNativeConstant(string $content): bool
    {
        $this->ensureConstantCaseContextReady();
        if (!$this->isKnownNativeConstantName($content)) {
            return false;
        }
        return $this->canonicalNativeConstantName($content) !== $content;
    }

    private function markConstantContextToken(Tokens $tokens, int $index): void
    {
        $this->ensureConstantCaseContextReady();
        if (!$tokens[$index]->isNativeConstant()) {
            return;
        }
        $this->recordConstantCandidate($index, $tokens[$index]->getContent());
    }

    private function constantCaseSnapshot(): array
    {
        $this->ensureConstantCaseContextReady();
        return [
            'context' => $this->constantCaseContext,
            'aliases' => $this->nativeConstantAliases,
            'callable' => \is_callable($this->fixFunction),
        ];
    }

    public function applyNativeTypeDeclarationCasing(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->hydrateSupportTables();
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        if ([] === $this->functionTypeHints) {
            return;
        }
        $this->fixNativeTypeFunctions($tokens);
        $this->fixNativeTypeClassConstantsAndProperties($tokens);
    }

    private function ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded(): void
    {
        if ([] !== $this->functionTypeHints && [] !== $this->classConstSupportedHints) {
            return;
        }
        $this->beforePropertyTypeTokens = ['{', ';', [T_PRIVATE], [T_PROTECTED], [T_PUBLIC], [T_VAR]];
        $this->functionTypeHints = [
            'array' => true, 'bool' => true, 'callable' => true, 'float' => true, 'int' => true,
            'iterable' => true, 'object' => true, 'self' => true, 'string' => true, 'void' => true,
        ];
        $this->classConstSupportedHints = [
            'array' => true, 'bool' => true, 'float' => true, 'int' => true, 'iterable' => true,
            'mixed' => true, 'null' => true, 'object' => true, 'parent' => true, 'self' => true,
            'string' => true, 'static' => true,
        ];
        $this->classPropertySupportedHints = [
            'array' => true, 'bool' => true, 'float' => true, 'int' => true, 'iterable' => true,
            'mixed' => true, 'null' => true, 'object' => true, 'parent' => true, 'self' => true,
            'static' => true, 'string' => true,
        ];
        $this->typeSeparationKinds = [
            CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION,
            CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION,
            CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_OPEN,
            CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_CLOSE,
        ];
        if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_00_00) {
            $this->functionTypeHints['false'] = true;
            $this->functionTypeHints['mixed'] = true;
            $this->functionTypeHints['null'] = true;
            $this->functionTypeHints['static'] = true;
        }
        if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_01_00) {
            $this->functionTypeHints['never'] = true;
            $this->beforePropertyTypeTokens[] = [T_READONLY];
        }
        if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_02_00) {
            $this->functionTypeHints['true'] = true;
        }
        foreach (['array','bool','callable','false','float','int','iterable','mixed','never','null','object','parent','self','static','string','true','void'] as $typeName) {
            $this->functionTypeHints[$typeName] = $this->functionTypeHints[$typeName] ?? false;
            $this->classConstSupportedHints[$typeName] = $this->classConstSupportedHints[$typeName] ?? false;
            $this->classPropertySupportedHints[$typeName] = $this->classPropertySupportedHints[$typeName] ?? false;
        }
    }
    private function fixNativeTypeFunctions(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $functionsAnalyzer = new FunctionsAnalyzer();
        for ($index = $tokens->count() - 1; $index >= 0; --$index) {
            if (!$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_FUNCTION, T_FN])) {
                continue;
            }
            $returnType = $functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionReturnType($tokens, $index);
            if (null !== $returnType) {
                $this->rewriteNativeTypeRange($tokens, $returnType->getStartIndex(), $returnType->getEndIndex(), $this->functionTypeHints);
            }
            foreach ($functionsAnalyzer->getFunctionArguments($tokens, $index) as $argument) {
                $type = $argument->getTypeAnalysis();
                if (null === $type) {
                    continue;
                }
                $this->rewriteNativeTypeRange($tokens, $type->getStartIndex(), $type->getEndIndex(), $this->functionTypeHints);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, true> $supportedTypeHints
     */
    private function rewriteNativeTypeRange(Tokens $tokens, int $startIndex, int $endIndex, array $supportedTypeHints): void
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        for ($index = $startIndex; $index <= $endIndex; ++$index) {
            $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
            if (null !== $nextIndex && $tokens[$nextIndex]->isGivenKind(T_NS_SEPARATOR)) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind($this->typeSeparationKinds)) {
                continue;
            }
            $this->rewriteNativeTypeTokenIfSupported($supportedTypeHints, $tokens, $index);
        }
    }

    private function fixNativeTypeClassConstantsAndProperties(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $elements = $this->classyElementsFor($tokens);
        $elements = array_reverse($elements, true);
        foreach ($elements as $index => $element) {
            if ('const' === $element['type']) {
                if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_03_00 && !$this->isNativeTypedConstWithoutType($tokens, $index)) {
                    foreach ($this->collectNativeTypeHintCandidatesForConstant($tokens, $index) as $nativeTypeHintIndex) {
                        $this->rewriteNativeTypeTokenIfSupported($this->classConstSupportedHints, $tokens, $nativeTypeHintIndex);
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            if ('property' === $element['type']) {
                foreach ($this->collectNativeTypeHintCandidatesForProperty($tokens, $index) as $nativeTypeHintIndex) {
                    $this->rewriteNativeTypeTokenIfSupported($this->classPropertySupportedHints, $tokens, $nativeTypeHintIndex);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** @return iterable<int> */
    private function collectNativeTypeHintCandidatesForConstant(Tokens $tokens, int $index): iterable
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $constNameIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, ['=']));
        $index = $this->firstIndexOfNativeType($tokens, $index);
        do {
            $typeEnd = $this->nativeTypeEnd($tokens, $index, $constNameIndex);
            if ($typeEnd === $index) {
                yield $index;
            }
            do {
                $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
            } while ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind($this->typeSeparationKinds));
        } while ($index < $constNameIndex);
    }

    /** @return iterable<int> */
    private function collectNativeTypeHintCandidatesForProperty(Tokens $tokens, int $index): iterable
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $propertyNameIndex = $index;
        $index = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($index, $this->beforePropertyTypeTokens);
        $index = $this->firstIndexOfNativeType($tokens, $index);
        do {
            $typeEnd = $this->nativeTypeEnd($tokens, $index, $propertyNameIndex);
            if ($typeEnd === $index) {
                yield $index;
            }
            do {
                $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
            } while ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind($this->typeSeparationKinds));
        } while ($index < $propertyNameIndex);
    }

    private function firstIndexOfNativeType(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE)) {
            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
        if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_OPEN)) {
            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
        return $index;
    }

    private function nativeTypeEnd(Tokens $tokens, int $index, int $upperLimit): int
    {
        if (!$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_STRING, T_NS_SEPARATOR])) {
            return $index;
        }
        $endIndex = $index;
        while ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_STRING, T_NS_SEPARATOR]) && $index < $upperLimit) {
            $endIndex = $index;
            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }
        return $endIndex;
    }

    private function isNativeTypedConstWithoutType(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        return $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_STRING) && $tokens[$tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index)]->equals('=');
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, true> $supportedTypeHints
     */
    private function rewriteNativeTypeTokenIfSupported(array $supportedTypeHints, Tokens $tokens, int $index): void
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $typeContent = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        $typeContentLower = strtolower($typeContent);
        if (isset($supportedTypeHints[$typeContentLower]) && $typeContent !== $typeContentLower) {
            $tokens[$index] = new Token([$tokens[$index]->getId(), $typeContentLower]);
        }
    }

    private function isSupportedFunctionTypeHint(string $typeName): bool
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $normalized = strtolower($typeName);
        return isset($this->functionTypeHints[$normalized]) && true === $this->functionTypeHints[$normalized];
    }

    private function isSupportedClassConstTypeHint(string $typeName): bool
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $normalized = strtolower($typeName);
        return isset($this->classConstSupportedHints[$normalized]) && true === $this->classConstSupportedHints[$normalized];
    }

    private function isSupportedClassPropertyTypeHint(string $typeName): bool
    {
        $this->ensureNativeTypeTablesLoaded();
        $normalized = strtolower($typeName);
        return isset($this->classPropertySupportedHints[$normalized]) && true === $this->classPropertySupportedHints[$normalized];
    }

    public function applyMagicMethodCasing(Tokens $tokens): void

                    $tokens[$index] = new Token([T_STRING, $nameInCorrectCasing]);
                }

            }

                $tokens[$index] = new Token([T_STRING, $nameInCorrectCasing]);
                continue;

namespace PhpCsFixer\Fixer\Casing;

use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\Fixer\ConfigurableFixerInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerConfigurationResolver;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerConfigurationResolverInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerConfiguration\FixerOptionBuilder;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\CodeSample;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinition;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinitionInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\CT;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Token;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Tokens;

/**
 * Fixer for constants case.
 *
 * @author Pol Dellaiera <pol.dellaiera@protonmail.com>
 */
final class ConstantCaseFixer extends AbstractFixer implements ConfigurableFixerInterface
{
    /**
     * Hold the function that will be used to convert the constants.
     *
     * @var callable
     */
    private $fixFunction;

    public function configure(array $configuration): void
    {
        parent::configure($configuration);

        if ('lower' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtolower($content);
        }

        if ('upper' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtoupper($content);
        }
    }

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'The PHP constants `true`, `false`, and `null` MUST be written using the correct casing.',
            [
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n"),
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n", ['case' => 'upper']),
            ]
        );
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_STRING);
    }

    protected function createConfigurationDefinition(): FixerConfigurationResolverInterface
    {
        return new FixerConfigurationResolver([
            (new FixerOptionBuilder('case', 'Whether to use the `upper` or `lower` case syntax.'))
                ->setAllowedValues(['upper', 'lower'])
                ->setDefault('lower')
                ->getOption(),
        ]);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $fixFunction = $this->fixFunction;

        foreach ($tokens as $index => $token) {
            if (!$token->isNativeConstant()) {
                continue;
            }

            $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);

            if (
                $this->isNeighbourAccepted($tokens, $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index))
                && $this->isNeighbourAccepted($tokens, $nextIndex)
                && !$tokens[$nextIndex]->equals('=')
                && !$this->isEnumCaseName($tokens, $index)
            ) {
                $tokens[$index] = new Token([$token->getId(), $fixFunction($token->getContent())]);
            }
        }
    }

    private function isNeighbourAccepted(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        static $forbiddenTokens = null;

        if (null === $forbiddenTokens) {
            $forbiddenTokens = [
                T_AS,
                T_CLASS,
                T_EXTENDS,
                T_IMPLEMENTS,
                T_INSTANCEOF,
                T_INSTEADOF,
                T_INTERFACE,
                T_NEW,
                T_NS_SEPARATOR,
                T_PAAMAYIM_NEKUDOTAYIM,
                T_TRAIT,
                T_USE,
                CT::T_USE_TRAIT,
                CT::T_USE_LAMBDA,
                ...Token::getObjectOperatorKinds(),
            ];
        }

        $token = $tokens[$index];

        if ($token->equalsAny(['{', '}'])) {
            return false;
        }

        return !$token->isGivenKind($forbiddenTokens);
    }

    private function isEnumCaseName(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if (!\defined('T_ENUM') || !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_ENUM)) { // @TODO: drop condition when PHP 8.1+ is required
            return false;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);

        if (null === $prevIndex || !$tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_CASE)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_SWITCH)) {
            return true;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($prevIndex, [[T_ENUM], [T_SWITCH]]);

        return null !== $prevIndex && $tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_ENUM);
    }
}
